new_state_note: That was a DEFECT and is CORRECTED. productionProfile is a caller argument that both live services already pass as true, INCLUDING on the DEVELOPMENT appliance, so the lock as first written would have refused to start there and would have changed the behaviour the accepted development trial depends on. The accepted dark-era assertion that every method defaults OFF caught it. The lock is now keyed on a BUILD TAG, stayconnect_production, which is also the seam the Product Owner named ('the final Production build') and the correct one on its own terms: a switch that decides which IAM authority is in force must not be reachable by the configuration it governs. The Production binary carries the answer inside it, and Config.SafeFlagSummary reports build=production or build=development at startup so the running profile is visible in a log rather than inferred. Both blockers remain CLOSED; the clean-room proof was re-run in full against the corrected implementation and still passes.
